messages.subject: output files empty
parts:
Hi all,

I am using the latest GGIR version for Geneactiv CSV data file for 7days with about two million rows(not epoch). The first few rows of the datafile is shown above. On using the code below and leaving overnight,  the code was still running and the  "meta" and "results" folder show up empty. Even on using a smaller file, I still get empty folders. I've tried everything, please let me know what I'm doing wrong. Any help would be greatly appreciated! 
CODE:

library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir="study_1/C4_049316 (week2) (2).csv",
             outputdir="/Users/apoorvasrinivasan/Desktop/hanga galfalvy/actigraphy",
             do.report=c(2,4,5),
             studyname = "study1",
             overwrite = FALSE,
             
             # Part 1
             #-------------------------------
             windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),           
             do.cal = TRUE,
             do.enmo = TRUE,            
             do.anglex=TRUE,             
             do.angley=TRUE,            
             do.anglez=TRUE,            
             chunksize=1,
             printsummary=TRUE,
             idloc = 2,                 
            
             #=====================
             # Part 2
             #=====================
             strategy = 1,
             hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
             maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
             qwindow=c(0,24),
             mvpathreshold =c(100),
             bout.metric = 4,
             excludefirstlast = FALSE,
             includenightcrit = 16,
          
             #=====================
             # Part 3 + 4
             #=====================
             def.noc.sleep = 1,
             outliers.only = TRUE,
             criterror = 4,
             do.visual = TRUE,
  
             #=====================
             # Part 5
             #=====================
             threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
             boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
             #=====================
             # Visual report
             #=====================
             timewindow = c("WW"),
             visualreport=TRUE)


All my best,
Apoorva

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] output files empty
parts:
GGIR has been thoroughly tested with GENEActiv .bin files.  Please try to work with the .bin files instead. 
I did some effort to facilitate GENEActiv .csv format, but this format changed a couple of times, by which compatibility may have gotten lost.

If working with .bin files is not an option for you then the GGIR code may need to be adapted to work with your data. Either find someone who can do this for you or you can hire me to do this. In the latter case, please contact me and we can discuss further.
Best, Vincent
